name: Shape Completion Training
aliases: Folding Grid Expansion for Shape Completion
definition: A decoder-based completion task that predicts all 14 Gaussian attributes from partial inputs without target coordinates, using a folding grid expansion.
summary: Shape Completion Training is a feed-forward method that predicts 3D Gaussian attributes from partial inputs using a fixed folding grid to expand coarse primitives, enabling reconstruction of missing geometry without per-scene optimization.
